content: {"reasoning":"The payer denied the service as noncovered under PR-204 after eligibility lapsed; the coding pair and COB order are valid, and no authorization was required. Resubmission, retro-authorization, medical-necessity appeal, and peer-to-peer review would not cure a plan-coverage exclusion, and similar patient-billing cases produced no payer recovery. With no secondary coverage, the remaining patient-responsibility balance should be billed to the patient rather than written off.","action":"bill_patient"}
